snippet.title: Lou's Lagoon Release Date Trailer | Wholesome Direct 2026
snippet.description: Lou's Lagoon is a cozy exploration and crafting adventure that sees you take to the skies across the Limbo Archipelago in search of your missing Uncle Lou who is missing after a storm. Harness your collection of trusty gadgets to collect resources, clean up the storm damaged islands and unravel the mystery surrounding Lou's disappearance. This Wholesome Direct trailer exclusively reveals the game's August 27 release date and the new demo out now on Steam. https://wholesomegames.com/ #summergamefest #wholesomedirect2026 #wholesomedirect
